1. A long time ago, there was a craftsman.
2. One day, Luban was at work on a mountain.
"How could such a small leaf hurt my finger?"
3. He looked at the leaf carefully.
There were many teeth on the leaf, and the teeth were sharp.
"Could I make a tool with teeth like these?
I could cut things with it easily," Luban said to himself.
It was the first saw in the world.
People are still using this tool today.
Alice has a pen holder. She got it from her friend, Anne.
Anne made the pen holder with paper and a can.
Tony made a paper doorknob and put it on the door.
But every time he opens the door, the doorknob falls onto the floor.
1. There lived a poor fisherman by the sea.
2. Can I take a look at your new camera? Sure.
3. Would you like a tour around the city?
4. My friend Polly has red hair and green eyes.
5. My little sister takes her teddy bear to bed every night.
6. Don't stand on the chair. You'll fall.
